g1.label: 1. English and French ___ in Canada
g1.why: Present passive: plural subject (English and French) + are + past participle.

g2.label: 2. Maple syrup ___ mostly in Quebec
g2.why: Present passive with a singular subject: is + past participle.

g3.label: 3. Many festivals ___
g3.why: 'Festivals' is plural, so the present passive is 'are celebrated'.

g4.label: 4. Ice hockey ___
g4.why: Ice hockey doesn't play itself, so use the passive: singular subject + is + played.

g5.label: 5. New immigrants ___
g5.why: 'Immigrants' is plural and receives the action, so use 'are welcomed'.

g6.label: 6. Multiculturalism ___ by Canadian law
g6.why: 'By Canadian law' shows the passive; singular subject + is + protected.

g7.label: 7. Diversity ___ as a strength
g7.why: Diversity is singular and receives the action, so the present passive is 'is seen'.

g8.label: 8. Different languages ___ at home
g8.why: 'Languages' is plural, so the present passive is 'are spoken'.

g1.label: 1. ___ official policy in 1971
g1.why: 'In 1971' needs the past passive; singular subject + was + made.

g2.label: 2. Canada ___ in 1867
g2.why: Past passive with a singular subject: was + past participle.

g3.label: 3. Thousands of new immigrants ___
g3.why: 'Immigrants' is plural and 'last year' is past, so use 'were welcomed'.

g4.label: 4. The festival ___ by volunteers
g4.why: 'By local volunteers' shows the passive; singular past is 'was organised'.

g5.label: 5. The law ___ by parliament
g5.why: Singular subject + past passive: was + passed.

g6.label: 6. Traditional foods ___
g6.why: 'Foods' is plural, so the past passive is 'were shared'.

g7.label: 7. The documentary ___
g7.why: The documentary is singular and receives the action: was + filmed.

g8.label: 8. The new citizens ___
g8.why: 'Citizens' is plural, so the past passive is 'were invited'.
